<span class="hidden" property="schema:name" content="Project Reporting"></span>

*Current as of 25-08-2026*

The ERC project reporting consists of **distinct scientific** and **periodic (financial)** reports that are due at different **interim** periods. For the final reporting period, the **scientific** and **periodic (financial)** reports need to be submitted simultaneously. 

These reports include: 

- **A narrative part**, which in Horizon Europe should be completed using a **downloadable Word template** **(see below)**, tailored to your specific grant.
- **A web-based part**, to be completed and submitted **directly through the** <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/home" class="ext" data-extlink="" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>Funding &amp; Tenders Portal</strong></a>**.** 

For more guidance on how to complete the [scientific](https://erc.europa.eu/manage-your-project/project-reporting#GuidanceforScientificReporting) and [financial](https://erc.europa.eu/manage-your-project/project-reporting#GuidanceforFinancialReporting) reports, expand the sections below.

 

- <a href="#_horizon-_europe-_e_r_c-reporting-templates-tab-0-name" class="tab-link" aria-controls="_horizon-_europe-_e_r_c-reporting-templates-tab-0-name" data-toggle="tab" role="tab">Horizon Europe ERC reporting templates</a>
- <a href="#_horizon-_europe-_e_r_c-reporting-templates-tab-1-name" class="tab-link" aria-controls="_horizon-_europe-_e_r_c-reporting-templates-tab-1-name" data-toggle="tab" role="tab">Horizon 2020 ERC project reporting</a>

##  

<a href="#WhatdoIneedtoknowabouttheERCProjectReporting" id="WhatdoIneedtoknowabouttheERCProjectReporting" class="ckeditor-accordion-toggler" onclick="return false;"><span class="ckeditor-accordion-toggle"></span>What do I need to know about the ERC Project Reporting?</a>  

 

In a typical 5-year Horizon Europe ERC project, the interim scientific report is due after month 24, while the financial report is due later, after month 30. The exact reporting periods are outlined in the Grant Agreement. 

At the end of each reporting period, you will receive a notification via the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/home" class="ext" data-extlink="" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><u>Funding and Tenders Portal</u></a> to complete your scientific or financial report in the newly opened module (i.e. “Scientific Reporting” or “Periodic Reporting”). 

You will note that part of the information is pre-filled with data that you have previously entered in the “Continuous Reporting” module, such as Publications or Project Summary. You may need to update this information to cover the whole reporting period of your report. 

Note that the “Continuous Reporting” module is activated when your project starts and remains active even after the end of the project, allowing you to add additional project results. You are invited to update the “Continuous Reporting” regularly, especially when your project produces important outcomes. 

For **Horizon Europe** projects, besides **the online part**, you need to download, complete and upload one of **the Word templates also available above**, applicable for your type of grant (see e.g. the “Scientific Report part B” tab). **For** **final reports**, you need to fill in **both a scientific** and **financial** report and upload them separately. Once completed, each report must be uploaded on the* Technical Report (Part B)*  section of the portal, under their corresponding field (i.e. “Scientific Progress report” and “Technical report Part B”). 

The complete reporting module must be submitted through the EU Funding & Tenders Portal (Technical guide). 

The ERC Executive Agency’s Scientific or Financial Officers will assess your scientific or financial reports and may contact you to request additional information, if they consider something is missing or not clear enough. 

For further guidance about what is expected in the scientific or financial reports, please consult the sections below.

<a href="#GuidanceforScientificReporting" id="GuidanceforScientificReporting" class="ckeditor-accordion-toggler" onclick="return false;"><span class="ckeditor-accordion-toggle"></span>Guidance for Scientific Reporting</a>  

 

The scientific reporting periods are set out in your Grant Agreement. These must be submitted within 60 days after each period ends, and need to capture the following: 

- In the **interim (or mid-term) scientific report**, you summarise the scientific progress that allows the Scientific Officers to monitor the implementation of the work and reported achievements against the commitments in your “Description of Action” (part B2 of your project proposal).   
    

- The **final report **submitted at the end of the project covers scientific and financial aspects. You are asked to report the work carried out and results obtained over the whole duration of your grant, including the scientific and societal impact of your research. 

As corresponding Principal Investigator of a **Synergy Grant**, the scientific reporting is similar to main grants, however with two interim scientific reports after months 24 and 48 of your project. **Proof of Concept** grantees are asked to submit a single final report at the end of the project. 

During the scientific reporting, a typical ERC project needs to **provide an overview** about the **progress and** **major achievements**, **key challenges and deviations from the plan**, **publications**, **dissemination activities**, **etc**. The “Scientific Reporting” module of the Funding and Tenders Portal will display the reporting sections you need to complete, which is composed of a narrative part and structured information. Note that the **Project Summary** is mandatory as will appear for the public on the <a href="https://cordis.europa.eu/" class="ext" data-extlink="" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><u>Cordis website</u></a> and should be a “stand-alone” text that is not linked to other parts of the report. It should not make reference to confidential or personal information ([<u>more information here</u>](https://erc.europa.eu/sites/default/files/document/file/ERC_Scientific_Reporting_Guidelines.pdf)). 

Note that the **Horizon Europe scientific report** is composed partly of web sections and a downloadable Word template also available in the above grid. The **Horizon 2020 scientific reports** have to be produced entirely online. 

**To assist you in preparing the scientific report, we invite you to consult the** [**<u>ERC Scientific Reporting Guidelines</u>**](https://erc.europa.eu/sites/default/files/document/file/ERC_Scientific_Reporting_Guidelines.pdf). 

If you have further questions in relation to your scientific report, we are also happy to support you: [<u>ERC-SCIENTIFIC-FOLLOW-UP@ec.europa.eu</u>](mailto:ERC-SCIENTIFIC-FOLLOW-UP@ec.europa.eu) 

<a href="#GuidanceforFinancialReporting" id="GuidanceforFinancialReporting" class="ckeditor-accordion-toggler" onclick="return false;"><span class="ckeditor-accordion-toggle"></span>Guidance for Financial Reporting</a>  

 

The **Periodic financial report** covers the financial aspects related to the implementation of your project.  

**The guidance and links available in this section refer to Horizon Europe ERC grants only**. For the financial reporting of Horizon 2020 grants, templates are directly available in the Funding & Tenders Portal. 

**When is the periodic report due for  submission?** 

The submission of Periodic reports is due within 60 days from the end of each reporting period. At the end of each reporting period/end of beneficiary participation, you will receive a notification via the Funding & Tenders Portal to complete your Periodic report. 

- The **Interim Periodic Report** typically covers the reporting period from Month 1 to Month 30. 
- The **Final Periodic Report** typically covers the reporting period from Month 31 to Month 60. This report also applies in case of **early grant termination**. N. B. For the final period, you need to submit also the Final Scientific Report ('single submission'). 
- In case of **early termination of a beneficiary’s participation**, a periodic report called “Beneficiary Termination Report” needs to be prepared by the terminated beneficiary, and submitted by the coordinator within 60 days from the end date of their participation. For ERC grants, this report is therefore needed when there is a change of Host Institution (with former host leaving the consortium), or in case of termination of an additional beneficiary (in a multi-beneficiary grant).  

**Which  documents are comprised in the Interim Periodic Report / Beneficiary Termination Report ?** 

- A **technical part** (“Technical Report (Part B)” interim) containing a description of the financial aspects related to the implementation of the project during the period of reference (e.g. time commitment, deviations in the use of the resources, …), 
-  A **financial part**, for each beneficiary (and affiliated entity, if applicable) **web based**, consisting of:  
  - An individual financial statement  
  - A consolidated financial statement 
  - A report on the use of resources  
  - A certificate on the financial statements (CFS), if required (to be downloaded from the Portal and re-uploaded as PDF). 

**Which  documents are comprised in the 'Final Periodic Report'?** 

- A **scientific part**, containing the description of the scientific progress of the action. 
-  A **technical part **(“Technical Report (Part B)” final)**,** containing the description of the financial aspects related to the implementation of the project during the period of reference (e.g. time commitment, deviations in the use of the resources, …), 

Once completed, the two parts of the Final Periodic Report must be uploaded on the *Technical Report (Part B)* screen of the portal, <u>under the respective section ('Scientific Progress Report' and 'Technical Report Part B')</u>. 

-  A **financial part**, for each beneficiary (and affiliated entity, if applicable) **web based, **consisting of:  
  - An individual financial statement  
  - A consolidated financial statement 
  - A report on the use of resources  
  - A certificate on the financial statements (CFS), if required (to be uploaded in the portal and reuploaded as PDF). 

**Proof of Concept** lump sums grants specificities are outlined in the scientific report section. 

**For more information on how to log in to your project and complete/upload/submit the report, please visit the page **<a href="https://webgate.ec.europa.eu/funding-tenders-opportunities/display/IT/Reporting+and+payments" class="ext" data-extlink="" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>IT How-to</strong></a>** of the EU Tenders & Funding Portal or the Technical Guide below.** 

<a href="#TechnicalGuide" id="TechnicalGuide" class="ckeditor-accordion-toggler" onclick="return false;"><span class="ckeditor-accordion-toggle"></span>Technical Guide</a>  

 

Detailed IT How-to technical guides are available as follows: (1) for scientific reporting <a href="https://webgate.ec.europa.eu/funding-tenders-opportunities/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=8912909#Scientificreportingprocess(RESC)-Step2:TheCoordinatorapprovestheScientificReport&amp;submitstotheEU" class="ext" data-extlink="" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><u>Horizon Europe here</u></a> or <a href="https://webgate.ec.europa.eu/funding-tenders-opportunities/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=8913121" class="ext" data-extlink="" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><u>Horizon 2020 here</u></a>; (2) for final reporting <a href="https://webgate.ec.europa.eu/funding-tenders-opportunities/display/IT/ERC+final+reporting#ERCfinalreporting-C.CompletingyourcontributiontotheScientificPartofthePeriodicReportc.CompletetheScientificPart" class="ext" data-extlink="" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><u>here</u></a><u>.</u> 

To open the “Scientific Reporting” or “Periodic Reporting” module, proceed with the following steps: 

**Log in** 

**Step 1:** Go to:   
<a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/myarea/projects" class="ext" data-extlink="" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><u>https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/myarea/projects</u></a>   
**Step 2:** Use your EU login credentials to log in   
**Step 3:** Navigate to (1) "My Project(s)" via the left-hand bar, (2) click on "Actions" next to your project, and then (3) select "Manage project". 

 

2.  **Click on “Scientific Reporting” or “Periodic Reporting”** 

 

3.  **Navigate through the different tabs of the report** 

e.g. here the “Project Summary”: 

  

4.  **Save the report** 

When all sections are completed, go back to the Research & Innovation – Grant Management Service window: 

 

5.  **To submit the scientific or financial report,** ensure you have a "Coordinator" or "Primary Coordinator" user profile in the Grant Management Service Portal and follow these 3 steps as described below:  (1) Lock for review -\> (2) Accept & include -\> (3) Submit to EU. **Detailed** **technical guide** <a href="https://webgate.ec.europa.eu/funding-tenders-opportunities/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=8912909#Scientificreportingprocess(RESC)-Step2:TheCoordinatorapprovestheScientificReport&amp;submitstotheEU" class="ext" data-extlink="" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong><u>here</u></strong></a>**.** 

Should you not have such a profile, please contact your Host Institution support services.
